Answers before you ask

Solar, made clear.

Still curious? Our solar advisors can walk through your roof, usage and goals with you.

Ask our team

Cost depends on system size, roof layout, equipment and whether you add battery storage. Solaris provides an itemized proposal after a free assessment, including projected production and savings.

Most residential panel installations are completed in one day. Design, permitting, inspection and utility approval happen before and after the installation date, and timing varies by location.

Solar panels have no moving parts and generally require little maintenance. Periodic monitoring, visual checks and cleaning when needed help keep output strong.

Warranty terms vary by panel, inverter, battery and installation package. Your Solaris proposal clearly lists the product and workmanship coverage included with your system.

Where available, net metering can credit you for eligible excess electricity your panels send to the grid. Rules and credit rates are set by local utilities, so we check the current program during your assessment.

Financing options may be available for qualified customers. We can explain the available payment structures and help you compare total costs before you decide.
